from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Encode divider-separated panels by the count of their marker cells."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_candidates = {
        color for color in range(10)
        if any(all(value == color for value in row) for row in grid)
        and any(all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) for c in range(w))
    }
    if not divider_candidates:
        raise ValueError("Expected a color forming full row and column dividers")
    divider = next(iter(divider_candidates))
    row_dividers = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == divider for v in grid[r])]
    col_dividers = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]

    def spans(length, separators):
        output = []
        start = 0
        for position in separators + [length]:
            if start < position:
                output.append(range(start, position))
            start = position + 1
        return output

    row_spans = spans(h, row_dividers)
    col_spans = spans(w, col_dividers)
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row if value != divider)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(value for value in counts if value != background)

    # Each panel turns into 1 if it contains two or more marker cells;
    # otherwise it retains the background color used inside the panels.
    return [
        [1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in rs for c in cs) >= 2 else background
         for cs in col_spans]
        for rs in row_spans]", "exit_code": 0, "error": null}
